svg.title: Opportunity Inbox Copilot — 5-layer data pipeline
svg.desc: Flowchart showing data moving from raw email input through 5 layers: ingestion, classification, extraction, scoring, and output assembly, ending in a ranked result card

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain Flow 1: the ingestion layer in detail')
sendPrompt('Explain Flow 1: the ingestion layer in detail')
sendPrompt('Explain Flow 1: the ingestion layer in full detail with examples')
g.text: split on delimiter / parse .eml / normalize to RawEmail objects
edge cases: too short, encoding errors, duplicates, >15 limit

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain Flow 2: the classification layer in full detail')
g.text: API Call #1 — all emails in one batch prompt

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain Flow 3: the extraction layer in full detail with the OpportunityObject schema')
g.text: API Call #2 — all opportunities in one batch prompt
output: OpportunityObject per email (deadline, CGPA, skills…)

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain Flow 4: the scoring engine with all four dimensions and the math')
g.text: deterministic Python: score + evidence strings + badge + rank

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain Flow 5: the output assembly layer and checklist generation')
g.text: API Call #3 — action checklists for all ranked items
fallback: Python-generated checklist if API fails

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Show me what the final ranked output card looks like')
g.text: ranked cards | score bars | badges | checklists
